# computesphere_queue_instance_types (Data Source)

Lists SphereQueue instance types: vCPU, memory, included disk, instance count, limits and the monthly price. Pass `environment_id` to get availability and prices for that environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    computesphere = {
      source  = "computesphere/computesphere"
      version = "~> 1.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Account ID for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
}

variable "api_url" {
  description = "API URL for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  default     = "api.computesphere.com"
}

provider "computesphere" {
  api_token  = var.api_token  # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_TOKEN env variable
  account_id = var.account_id # or set COMPUTESPHERE_ACCOUNT_ID env variable
  api_url    = var.api_url    # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_URL env variable
}

data "computesphere_queue_instance_types" "example" {
  environment_id = var.environment_id # optional: check availability for this environment
}

variable "environment_id" {
  description = "Environment to check availability for"
  type        = string
}

output "three_member_queue_sizes" {
  value = [for t in data.computesphere_queue_instance_types.example.instance_types : "${t.name} (${t.id})" if t.available && t.instances == 3]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Price and check availability for this environment.

### Read-Only

- `instance_types` (Attributes List) The instance types, smallest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_types))

<a id="nestedatt--instance_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instance_types`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) False when the type can't be created here.
- `engine` (String) Broker engine.
- `family` (String) `free` and `shared`: a virtual host on a shared broker. `dedicated`: a broker of your own.
- `high_availability` (Boolean) True on a three-member type.
- `high_availability_type` (String) The three-member twin of a one-member size; null when there is none.
- `id` (String) Instance type id used on `computesphere_queue`, e.g. `sq-1c-2g-s20g`.
- `instances` (Number) Instances in the broker: 1, or 3 on a high-availability type (an id ending in `-ha`), across three zones with quorum queues.
- `max_connections` (Number) Connection limit; 0 means no fixed limit.
- `max_queues` (Number) Queue limit; 0 means no fixed limit.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory per member in MB; null on shared types.
- `monthly_price_cents` (Number) Monthly price in USD cents for the region's price group; null until prices are published.
- `name` (String) Display name, e.g. `Queue 1`.
- `price_group` (String) `standard` or `premium`.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Disk included per member for queued messages; null on shared types.
- `unavailable_reason` (String) Why it's unavailable; null when available.
- `vcpu` (Number) vCPU per member; null on shared types.
